sections.title: NRN ROCKIES AND ADJACENT HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: WHILE PRIMARY TROUGH POSITION REMAINS NEAR W COAST...A COUPLE S/WV IMPULSES WILL BE TRACKING ENEWD ACROSS NRN ROCKIES TODAY. STRONGEST ONE CURRENTLY MOVING ACROSS NRN ID INTO WRN MT THIS AM. A WEAKER BUT STILL NOTICEABLE VORT MAX ON IR AND WV IMAGERY IS IN W CENTRAL WY TRACKING SLOWLY ENEWD. WHILE MOISTURE IS LIMITED ACROSS WRN MT THE VERY STEEP LAPSE RATES ACCOMPANYING THE S/WV TROUGH WILL LEAD TO SUFFICIENT INSTABILITY FOR THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT BY AFTERNOON OFF THE HIGHER TERRAIN. WHILE MLCAPES WILL ONLY BE IN THE 500-1000 J/KG RANGE WITH PWATS AROUND .75 INCHES...THE DCAPES WITH THE STEEP LAPSE RATES WILL BE WELL OVER 1000 J/KG. COUPLED WITH 35-40KT OF SHEAR...DAMAGING DOWNBURST WINDS WILL BE LIKELY IN THE STRONGEST THUNDERSTORMS. CONVECTION WELL DEVELOP EWD OUT INTO THE PLAINS OF ERN MT THRU THE EVENING WHERE SOMEWHAT BETTER MOISTURE AND MLCAPES UP TO 1500 J/KG WILL RESIDE. IN ADDITION TO POTENTIAL FOR DEVELOPMENT OF SHORT LINES/BOWS...ISOLATED SUPERCELLS WILL ALSO BE POSSIBLE. THUS A THREAT OF DAMAGING WINDS WILL CONTINUE EWD WITH A GREATER CHANCE OF LARGE HAIL AND A TORNADO WITH ANY SUPERCELL DEVELOPMENT. sections.title: SERN STATES
sections.text: ONCE AGAIN THE VERY MOIST AIR MASS COVERS THE SERN STATES TO S OF COLD FRONT THAT CURRENTLY EXTENDS FROM SRN VA WSWWD THRU TN VALLEY. WITH PWAT IN EXCESS OF 2 INCHES AND STRONG HEATING MLCAPES ARE CLIMBING TO ABOVE 2500-3000 J/KG. THIS INCLUDES MUCH OF SC INTO NRN GA WHERE THE CONVECTIVE TEMPERATURES WILL BE REACHED SHORTLY. WHILE THE STRONGEST WESTERLIES WITH THE TROUGH PASSING ACROSS THE NERN STATES WILL REMAIN WELL N OF THE UNSTABLE SERN AIR MASS...THE 15-20KT OF DEEP LAYER SHEAR COUPLED WITH THE DCAPES IN EXCESS OF 1000 J/KG IN THE VERY MOIST AIR MASS FAVORS STORMS DEVELOPING INTO CLUSTERS AND SHORT LINE SEGMENTS. COLD POOL DEVELOPMENT WILL LEAD TO SOME ORGANIZED WIND DAMAGE THREAT FROM E OF THE SRN APPALACHIANS SEWD TO THE COAST. ..HALES/GRAMS.. 08/06/2010

sections.title: 20Z UPDATE
sections.text: ...NORTHERN ROCKIES/PLAINS... WEAK TO MODERATE DESTABILIZATION APPEARS LIKELY TO REMAIN CONFINED TO SCATTERED POCKETS ACROSS THE REGION LATE THIS AFTERNOON...GIVEN THE LACK OF MORE UNIFORMLY HIGHER MOISTURE LEVELS. COUPLED WITH THE RATHER MODEST...AT BEST...NATURE OF THE WESTERLY DEEP LAYER MEAN FLOW FIELDS AND SHEAR...THE JUSTIFICATION FOR MAINTAINING SLIGHT RISK PROBABILITIES OVER A FAIRLY SIZABLE AREA MAY BE SOMEWHAT QUESTIONABLE. HOWEVER...FORCING ASSOCIATED WITH ONE SHORT WAVE IMPULSE LIFTING NORTH OF THE SNAKE RIVER VALLEY INTO THE MOUNTAINS OF SOUTHWEST MONTANA LATE THIS AFTERNOON MAY CONTRIBUTE TO SCATTERED STORM DEVELOPMENT WHICH WILL PROBABLY SPREAD EAST NORTHEAST OF THE HIGHER TERRAIN INTO PARTS OF CENTRAL AND EASTERN MONTANA THIS EVENING. IT IS NOT OUT OF THE QUESTION THAT FORCING ON THE NOSE OF A STRENGTHENING SOUTHERLY 850 MB JET /30-40 KT/ COULD CONTRIBUTE TO THE EVOLUTION OF A SMALL MESOSCALE CONVECTIVE SYSTEM THIS EVENING...NORTHWEST THROUGH NORTH OF THE BLACK HILLS...ACROSS SOUTHEASTERN MONTANA INTO THE WESTERN DAKOTAS...WHERE HIGHER MOISTURE CONTENT AND MODERATE CAPE EXIST. IF THIS OCCURS...THERMODYNAMIC PROFILES SHOULD BE FAVORABLE FOR THE DEVELOPMENT OF A SUBST

sections.title: SOUTHEAST
sections.text: A ZONE OF STRONGER FORCING DEVELOPING EAST SOUTHEASTWARD WITHIN THE BASE OF THE LARGE-SCALE TROUGH TO THE NORTH OF THE REGION APPEARS LIKELY TO CONTINUE TO GRADUALLY SPREAD SOUTHEAST OF THE SOUTHERN APPALACHIANS THROUGH PARTS OF NORTHERN GEORGIA AND SOUTH CAROLINA LATE THIS AFTERNOON. ACCOUNTING FOR THIS...SEVERE PROBABILITIES HAVE BEEN LOWERED BELOW THE SLIGHT RISK THRESHOLD ACROSS NORTH CAROLINA. OTHERWISE...THE REMAINDER OF THE OUTLOOK IS UNCHANGED. ..KERR.. 08/06/2010 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1126 AM CDT FRI AUG 06 2010/
